'''''Applied Psychological Measurement''''' is a [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by [[SAGE Publications]]. The journal covers research on methodologies and research on the application of psychological measurement in [[psychology]] and related disciplines, as well as reviews of [[book review|books]] and computer programs. The journal's [[editor-in-chief]] is John R. Donoghue ([[Educational Testing Service]]). ''Applied Psychological Measurement'' was featured in ''[[Institute for Scientific Information|ScienceWatch]]'' in May 2011, as the number of citations to the journal placed it among highly cited journals in the fields of [[psychiatry]] and psychology.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sciencewatch.com/inter/jou/2011/11mayApldPsyMeas/ |title=The History & Citation Impact of ''Applied Psychological Measurement'' |year=2011 |accessdate=2011-07-22| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20110608174433/http://sciencewatch.com/inter/jou/2011/11mayApldPsyMeas/| archivedate= 8 June 2011 | url-status= live}}</ref>

== Abstracting and indexing ==
''Applied Psychological Measurement'' is abstracted and indexed in [[Scopus]] and the [[Social Sciences Citation Index]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', its 2021 [[impact factor]] is 1.522, ranking it 9th out of 13 journals in the category "Psychology, Mathematical"<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Psychology, Mathematical |title=2021 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Social Sciences |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref> 38th out of 53 in the category "Social Sciences, Mathematical Models".<ref name=WoS2>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Social Sciences, Mathematical Models |title=2021 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Social Sciences |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref>
